title: Momo Chutney
description: The fiery red dip served with momos: a glossy, garlic-heavy Kashmiri chilli paste that is sweet, sour and savoury.

ingredients.note: for vibrant colour and mild heat
vegetable, or sesame for a more authentic aroma

steps: Remove the stems from the dry chillies. Soak them in hot water for 30 minutes until soft. Deseed them only if you want it less spicy.
Drain the chillies and blend them into a smooth, thick red paste using a minimal amount of water.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and ginger and sauté until aromatic and light golden. Do not let the garlic turn dark brown.
Add the chilli paste and mix well. Cook on medium-low heat until the oil begins to separate from the edges.
Stir in the tomato sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, black pepper powder and salt.
Mix thoroughly and cook for another 3–5 minutes, until the oil separates again.
Turn off the heat and let the chutney cool completely. Transfer to a clean, airtight glass jar.
notes: Use a clean, dry spoon for serving so the chutney keeps longer.
